items.actClause:
AN ACT enacting the "Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act";
and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S7225

SPONSOR: MANNION
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act enacting the "Syracuse regional airport authority design-build
act"; and providing for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration
thereof

 
PURPOSE:

The purpose of this bill is to authorize the Syracuse Regional Airport
Authority to utilize alternative delivery methods, known as design-
build, for certain projects at the Syracuse Hancock International
Airport.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1 of this bill would provide that the act shall be cited as the
"Syracuse Regional Airport Authority Design-Build Act".

Section 2 of this bill would define relevant terms.

Section 3 of this bill would require the utilization of a project labor
agreement in conformity with the labor law for authorized projects,
undertaken by the authorized entity.

Section 4 of this bill would detail the two-step method that the author-
ized entity must enter for selecting a contractor, including the method
for request, selection of a contractor, and conformity with existing
provisions of the Labor and Executive Law.

Section 5 of this bill would require that the contract between an
authorized entity and a contractor include a clause that professional
services be rendered by licensed professionals.

Section 6 of this bill would designate the project as "public work" for
purposes of conformity with the Labor Law.

Section 7 of this bill would require compliance with the minority- and
women-owned business enterprises provisions of the Executive Law.

Section 8 of this bill would require compliance, with the State Environ-
mental Quality Review Act and the National Environmental Policy Act.

Section 9 of this bill would preserve collective bargaining rights of
employees of the authorized entity in connection with the public works
projects authorized by the act.

Section 10 of this bill would clarify that utilization of this act by
the authorized entity does not constitute a violation of the Education
Law.

Section 11 of this bill would require that this act shall not obviate or
limit the right or obligation of any authorized entity to comply with
the provisions of existing law or to award contracts as otherwise
provided by law.


Section 12 of this bill provides that the effective date shall take
effect immediately and shall expire and be deemed repealed two years
after such date; provided, however, that, public works with requests for
qualifications issued prior to such repeal shall be permitted to contin-
ue under this act notwithstanding such repeal.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

The Syracuse Regional Airport Authority (the Authority) was established
by Chapter 463 of the Laws of 2011, which granted broad reaching general
and special powers to the Authority. This bill would clarify that those
powers include the utilization of the design-build method for a limited
number of specific projects as outlined in the bill. To ensure conformi-
ty and deference to the work conducted by the workers who would actually
build the projects, the design-build authorization includes strict
adherence to applicable provisions of the Labor and Executive Law. These
guardrails would ensure that, for example, peace labor agreements are
used by the Authority, amongst other requirements. This authorization is
necessary given the complexities and estimated project costs for the
airport, and the arrival of Micron in the neighboring municipality.

Design-build is a construction project method wherein the design team
and the contractor team work together under a single entity. This method
allows designers and contractors to work together and collaboratively
solve any problems that may arise during the project.  As a result, this
method saves time and money for all parties involved in a project, and
under the parameters of this bill, would ensure conformity with
provisions of the Labor and Executive Law.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

New bill.

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately and shall expire and be deemed
repealed two years after such date; provided, however, that, public
works with requests for qualifications issued prior to such repeal shall
be permitted to continue under this act notwithstanding such repeal.

summary: Enacts the "Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act" allowing for the Syracuse regional airport authority to enter into a design-build contract for the installation, construction, demolition, reconstruction, excavation, rehabilitation, repair, and renovation in connection with a landside improvement project, terminal operational enhancement and aircraft deicing facility located in the towns of Cicero, De Witt and Salina at the Syracuse Hancock International Airport.
title: Enacts the Syracuse regional airport authority design-build act
